environment.description: ECS Fargate service running on platform version 1.4.0, single container task with static environment variables injected via task definition plaintext. ALB forwards all traffic directly to target group on port 8080. No session management middleware. DB_AUTH_TOKEN is a long-lived IAM database auth token generated at deploy time with 15-minute validity, manually refreshed only on redeployment.

config.alb_config: simple pass-through, no WAF, no managed rules
